notes.title: Version 1.0.9 - Cameras!
notes.notes:
We heard you loud and clear. You can now change your camera angle by pressing C (Keyboard), X (XBOX), or Square (PS) in game.

We also enhanced the primary camera angle so you can see the 3D a bit more.

Thanks for playing Lightbender and keep the suggestions coming! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Version 1.0.8 - Progress Bars
notes.notes:
In this update, we've added progress bars to the level packs screen. You can now see how much of the pack you've completed at a glance. A star appears next to the pack if you've completed it.

Download 1.0.8 today!

notes.title: Version 1.0.7 - Lots of Minor Fixes
notes.notes:
In this update:

- You can now skip the intro by pressing Escape
- In the level creator, Escape now unpauses the game.
- Fixed a bug where "Pressing confirm to continue" on the last level of a level pack would automatically reload the level. It now shows the You Win menu.
- Fixed a bug where Fullscreen preferences were ignored when changing resolutions.
- Improved the scrolling in the resolution menu. It no longer jumps when scrolling up.

Extra special thanks to @ProfessorOhki for finding these. 

Thanks for playing Lightbender! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Version 1.0.6 - Level Complete
notes.notes:
This update removes the automatic popup "You Win" when you finish a level. It now shows a smaller popup that fades in and out so that you can still see the level after you solve it.

Just press A, Enter, etc. to continue to the familiar "You Win" menu.

notes.title: Version 1.0.1 + Poll
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

In response to a few comments, I've put out a new version of the game that has removed the mouse cursor from view.

When I was originally making this game several months ago, the mouse was the primary way of navigating through the game; however, as development progressed, it became more evident that the game was more suited for a gamepad, which does not have any mouse support.

In it's current state, the game is recommended to be played on a gamepad or solely with the keyboard (WASD/Arrow Keys, Enter, Esc/Backspace). You can see the full control scheme on the last screenshot on our store page.

So I'm reaching out to you all now to find out what you think: do you want me to implement full mouse menu controls, or are you happy with gamepad-style navigation alone?
